此版本为原生架构重建前最后一个版本。
This is the final release before the native architecture rebuild.

## 新界面支持 macOS 12 及以上 | The new interface on macOS 12 and later

全新主界面、设置与无主机页支持 macOS 12 至 26，旧系统上同样可用；经典主页可随时切回。
The new main window, Settings and the no-computer page now support macOS 12 through 26, and the classic home page is one switch away.

## 其他改进 | More improvements

- 全新无主机页，可自动发现局域网内的电脑，找到后平滑进入主机列表。
  A new page for when no computer is set up yet: computers on the local network are found automatically and slide into the list.
- 提供“经典主页”开关，需要时可回到原来的主页。
  A Classic Home Page switch is available for those who prefer the previous layout.
- 改进触屏 Mac 与随航 iPad 上的单指轻点与拖动。
  Improved single-finger tap and drag on touchscreen Macs and Sidecar iPads.

## 修复 | Fixes

- 修复 macOS 14 与 15 上主窗口内容空白、无法添加主机（[#90](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/90)）。
  Fixed a blank main window on macOS 14 and 15 that prevented adding a computer ([#90](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/90)).
- 修复 USB 映射页提示“格式不正确”、设备列表为空（[#86](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/86)）。
  Fixed the USB Mapping page reporting a malformed format with an empty device list ([#86](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/86)).
- 修复局域网内新发现的电脑没有出现在主机列表中。
  Fixed computers newly discovered on the local network not appearing in the list.
- 修复点击配对后最长约 25 秒才出现 PIN（Foundation Sunshine 主机）。
  Fixed the PIN appearing up to about 25 seconds after pressing Pair (Foundation Sunshine hosts).
- 减少自由鼠标下光标漂移抖动（[#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)）。
  Reduced cursor drift and jitter in free mouse mode ([#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)).

<details><summary>详细变更 | Detailed changes</summary>

#### 兼容性 | Compatibility

- 新主页、叠层设置页和无主机页在 macOS 12–26 上是同一套界面，外观按系统版本降级、功能不缺；性能浮窗的样式设置页从 macOS 13 起提供，macOS 12 上串流中保持原来的单行浮窗。
  The new home, the overlay Settings pages and the no-computer page are one interface on macOS 12–26, with appearance adapted to the system version and no missing features; the performance HUD style page starts at macOS 13, and on macOS 12 the stream keeps the single-line HUD.
- 工程把“可用性保护缺失”当作编译错误，旧系统上调用新 API 的遗漏会在构建时被发现。
  The project treats missing availability guards as build errors, so calls to newer APIs on older systems are caught at build time.

#### 发现与配对 | Discovery and pairing

- 局域网发现等探测结果写入后再把新电脑加入列表，同一台电脑的重复回调不会重复加入。
  A newly discovered computer is added to the list only after its probe result is stored, and repeated callbacks for the same computer no longer add it twice.
- 停止发现时立即结束在途的事件长轮询，点击配对不再等待它返回；事件订阅在重新开始发现时自动恢复。
  Stopping discovery ends an in-flight event long-poll at once, so Pair no longer waits for it; the event subscription resumes when discovery restarts.

#### 输入与 USB | Input and USB

- 自由鼠标：CoreHID 正在送出移动的 0.25 秒内不再重复发送系统的鼠标移动事件；触控板等 CoreHID 不负责的指针不受影响。
  Free mouse: while CoreHID is delivering movement (0.25 s), the duplicate system mouse-moved events are no longer sent; pointers CoreHID does not handle, such as trackpads, are unaffected.
- 触屏：直接触控改走拖动手势识别，鼠标与触控板的点击不受影响。
  Touch: direct touch now goes through a drag gesture recognizer, and mouse and trackpad clicks are unaffected.
- USB 映射页：设备列表读取失败时显示固定提示，不再展示底层解析错误。
  USB Mapping: a failed device list read shows a fixed message instead of the underlying parse error.

</details>
